subject.title: fix(doctor): bound legacy session store read with size cap and stat-failure fix

question: Should Doctor reject valid legacy session stores above 50 MiB, or must it retain a supported migration path for those existing stores while hardening the TOCTOU read?
rationale: Current behavior shown by the removed path had no size rejection, so choosing a fixed migration cutoff changes upgrade behavior and cannot be resolved safely from the patch alone.

options.title: Preserve a supported large-store migration path
options.body: Keep the descriptor-bound race fix but revise the limit or migration flow so valid existing stores above 50 MiB are not newly stranded.

options.title: Accept the hard 50 MiB cutoff
options.body: Treat oversized legacy stores as intentionally unsupported, with explicit upgrade guidance and owner-approved compatibility rationale.

recommendation.title: Preserve a supported large-store migration path
recommendation.body: Keep the descriptor-bound race fix but revise the limit or migration flow so valid existing stores above 50 MiB are not newly stranded.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires a repository-level compatibility decision for Doctor migration behavior rather than a contributor-only code correction.
